d: Core42, a leader in AI-powered cloud and digital infrastructure, is driving transformative technology solutions globally. Leveraging advanced resources and partnerships, Core42 empowers clients to harness sovereign AI infrastructure, especially in sectors with stringent regulatory needs. With a mission to redefine digital transformation, we combine sovereign capabilities with scalable, high-performance compute infrastructure, positioning itself at the forefront of AI innovation in the Middle East and beyond.

We are seeking an innovative, creative and experienced Backend Engineer to build the structure of advanced software applications by writing flawless business logic, server scripts and APIs. You’ll design, build and test complex programs and integration services, contribute to architecture discussions, and develop optimal solutions that enhance user experience while maximising speed, scalability and technical feasibility. Your performance will be measured by cost savings achieved, reduction in productivity loss, processes optimised, defect-free delivery, adherence to policies, procedures and quality standards, and customer NPS.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering or a related field
At least 2 years of experience in Java Spring Boot and microservices development
Proficiency in working with message queues such as AMQ, RabbitMQ or Kafka
Proven experience in developing RESTful APIs
Proficiency in understanding data, entity relationships, structured and unstructured data, and SQL and NoSQL databases; familiarity with Elasticsearch is preferred
Practical experience in multithreading and concurrency programming
Familiarity with Maven, UNIX/Linux and shell scripting
Experience with process engines such as Activiti, Flowable or Camunda
Familiarity with AWS or Azure cloud services
A passion for constant improvement and an innovative, creative approach to problem-solving
r: Create and communicate multiple design views to identify and balance the concerns of all stakeholders of software design, covering both functional and non-functional requirements
Model or simulate the behaviour of proposed software to enable approval by stakeholders and facilitate effective construction of the software
Design, code, verify, test, document, amend and re-factor complex programs/scripts and integration software services
Define and manage scoping, requirement definition and prioritisation activities for small-scale changes, and assist with more complex change initiatives
Follow agreed standards and apply appropriate techniques to elicit and document detailed requirements
Contribute to the selection of an appropriate software development approach, whether predictive (plan-driven) or adaptive (iterative/agile)
Design test cases and test scripts mapped to pre-determined criteria, clearly recording and reporting outcomes
Develop and maintain specialist knowledge of database and data warehouse concepts, design principles, architecture, software and facilities
Develop optimal solutions to enhance user experience, optimising for maximum speed, scalability and technical feasibility
Participate in architecture discussions to gain a detailed understanding of the complete architecture of a product and its functionalities
Build reusable code and libraries for future use
x: With a diverse team of 1,100+ employees from 68 nationalities, we foster an inclusive, innovative and collaborative environment. At Core42, we foster a culture grounded in trust, accountability and high performance. We are united by our values: Grit, where we overcome challenges with resilience and determination, Passion, which drives us to pursue excellence in everything we do, and Impact, as we aim to inspire progress and create meaningful change. Our team members thrive in an environment where each person’s contributions propel us forward, and together, we commit to achieving extraordinary results.

Yearly Bonus: In recognition of your contributions, you will receive a performance-based annual bonus
Exclusive Discount Cards: Access special benefits with Esaad and Fazaa cards, offering discounts across a wide range of services
Premium Family Insurance: We provide comprehensive health coverage, including dental, vision and life insurance, ensuring the well-being of you and your family

d: The IT Service Operations Manager leads the IT Service Desk for the company and the Field Support teams across the UAE, Bahrain, Oman and Qatar. The role is accountable for the quality of IT support and the end-user experience for all GIG Gulf employees, and serves as the primary point of contact between IT and the business for support and service requests.

The role supports all end users and provides first-line support for all applications managed by the IT platform teams. It is responsible for IT communications to the business, user account and access management across all applications, the IT asset management platform, office IT services across locations and the Service Operations budget. The jobholder is expected to lead through the team, take decisions and actions to documented closure, escalate risks in a timely manner and report on service performance with accurate, evidence-based information
q: Minimum 8 years' experience in IT service operations, including at least 4 years leading Service Desk and/or Field Support teams, preferably across multiple countries. Bachelor's degree in IT or equivalent experience.
Proven people leadership with a track record of measurable results, effective performance management and strong follow-up.
Practical application of ITIL and strong experience with ITSM and asset management tools (ManageEngine or similar).
Sound working knowledge of Windows 11, Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, Teams events, video-conferencing, networking fundamentals and communication room infrastructure.
Experience in budget management, procurement, vendor contracts and data analysis (Excel or Power BI).
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, and willingness to travel regularly within the GCC.
r: Manage the Service Desk as the single point of contact for IT support across all countries, ensuring incidents and service requests are delivered within agreed SLAs and that aged tickets are actively owned, reviewed and resolved.

Provide first-line support for all applications managed by the platform teams and coordinate second-line resolution with them. Agree support models, escalation matrices and knowledge transfer prior to the go-live of new applications.
Monitor resolver queues and escalations across all teams, and own the ITSM tool, including the service catalogue, workflows, SLA configuration and reporting.
Major Incident Management and IT Communications
Coordinate the response to major user-impacting incidents with Infrastructure, Security, platform teams and vendors, ensuring root cause analysis, corrective actions and verified closure.

Act as the authorised sender of IT communications to the business for incidents, planned maintenance and enhancements, ensuring communications are accurate, timely, appropriately targeted and issued in the approved format.
Review and approve user-impacting changes at CAB, ensure each change is supported by appropriate communication, and confirm service normalisation through post-change user checks.
End-User Computing, Field Support and Events

Lead Field Support across all four countries, covering device provisioning, managed software deployment, patching & vulnerability management, laptop backup and restoration, and device refresh programmes such as the Windows 11 transition.
Manage laptops and mobile devices, SIMs and telephony, desktops, printing and managed print services, and the daily readiness of meeting rooms and video conferencing facilities.

Plan and deliver IT support for corporate events at single or multiple locations, including requirement definition, Microsoft Teams meetings, webinars and Town Halls, VC and AV arrangements, vendor quotations, rehearsals and on-the-day support.
Provide prioritised and discreet support to the executive users.

Represent IT at all GIG Gulf offices, particularly where Field Support is the only IT presence, and ensure communication rooms, UPS, cooling, cabling and local circuits are maintained in coordination with Facilities, landlords, ISPs(for telco & SIP) and local vendors.
Provide on-site support for activities performed remotely by central teams, and deliver the IT requirements of office relocations, refurbishments and new site set-ups through to completion.
Access Management, IT Assets and CMDB

Own the joiner, mover and leaver process for all applications, as the Service Desk creates and removes all user IDs. This includes privileged access and software requests, the retention and handover of leavers' data prior to deletion, periodic access reviews and audit evidence.

Own the IT asset management platform end to end and, where it no longer meets business needs, lead the evaluation, business case, Technical Review Board approval and migration to a suitable replacement.
Maintain the accuracy of the asset register and CMDB through half-yearly validation, physical audits and reconciliation, and manage the asset lifecycle through to certified disposal.

Lead ticket reduction and ticket avoidance initiatives across all CTTO teams, with defined baselines, owners, monthly targets and evidence of benefit, supported by self-service, automation and Microsoft Copilot.

Own the Service Desk KPIs, including speed to answer, SLA compliance, first-contact resolution, backlog and customer satisfaction, and manage the customer satisfaction survey process. Reporting should focus on outcomes and be based on validated data.

Own and review annually all Service Operations processes, SOPs and end-user policies, including Incident Management, Asset management, device usage and mailbox policies, and any related ones, to ensure they remain current and audit-ready.
Develop and maintain an annual Service Operations roadmap aligned with the IT Operations strategy.
Prepare and manage the Service Operations budget and contribute to capital planning, ensuring that decisions and expenditure are completed within the approved budget cycle.

Manage procurement in line with GIG policy, from requirements, quotations and RFPs for outsourced services through to purchase orders, receipts and invoices. Manage Microsoft 365, Copilot and other licences, contract renewals and vendor SLA performance.

Lead, coach and develop the team by setting clear objectives, conducting regular one-to-ones, maintaining development and technical training plans, addressing team concerns and underperformance promptly, and ensuring compliance with HR processes such as leave and attendance.

Plan rosters, on-call and after-hours cover, and maintain service continuity arrangements, including cross-trained Field Support staff able to operate the Service Desk if the Bahrain site is unavailable. Support DR tests from an end-user perspective.

Drive decisions to documented closure, escalate risks in a timely manner, respond to emails and approvals within agreed timelines, maintain an up-to-date action tracker, and sustain business-as-usual operations alongside project delivery. Projects must have a plan, defined success criteria and a formal Go/No-Go decision.
Engage regularly with business heads, provide structured progress reporting to the Head of IT Operations, and support audits and security incident response.
The manner in which the role is performed is considered as important as its technical delivery. The jobholder is expected to demonstrate the following behaviors:

Ownership and accountability: Takes full responsibility for service outcomes, acts proactively and addresses root causes rather than symptoms. Deals with the stressful and demanding situations with thorough maturity.
Follow-through: Tracks commitments to closure and provides updates without the need for reminders.
Results orientation: Demonstrates measurable outcomes supported by data, rather than reporting activity.
Decision-making and transparency: Makes timely decisions under pressure and escalates risks and issues early and openly.
Leadership through others: Delegates effectively, develops team members and measures success by team performance.
Performance management: Provides fair and constructive feedback, recognizes good performance and addresses concerns promptly.
Communication and composure: Communicates clearly with all audiences and remains composed during major incidents and critical events.
Customer focus: Listens actively, understands business impact and confirms resolution with the user before closure.
Integrity and compliance: Adheres to policies on access, procurement, security and change management, and exercises sound cost discipline.
Flexibility and continuous learning: Supports after-hours requirements when needed, embraces new tools and technologies, and responds constructively to feedback.
